lexical.coordinates: zero-based UTF-8 byte offsets plus zero-based UTF-16 columns

productions.workflow: workflow identifier ('@' string)? ('version'|'revision')? '(' (identifier ':' type)? ')' (('->'|'returns'|'output') ':'? type)? ('routing' ':' string)? '{' node* '}'
productions.contextNode: context identifier ('=' context)? descriptor arguments ('->'|':')? type? ';'?
productions.activityNode: activity identifier ('=' activity)? descriptor arguments ('->'|':')? type? ';'?
productions.inferenceNode: infer identifier ('=' infer)? descriptor ('using'|',') descriptor arguments? ('with'|'context') identifier (',' identifier)* ('->'|':')? type? ';'?
productions.type: string | bool | boolean | int | integer | number | duration | json | identifier | list '<' type '>' ('[' number ']')? | artifact '<' descriptor '>'

semanticRules: Descriptor pins are exact kind, name, version, and sha256 descriptor/v1 digest identities.
Conditional branches are control-only; branch-local return values cannot escape the branch.
A workflow has one complete return and no cross-region output references.
The trusted catalogue, not source text, is authoritative for schemas and callable contracts.
All parser dimensions are bounded by CompilationBudget; diagnostic codes are stable API values.
